title: TypeSomething (v2)
description: Warm and friendly: a warm paper page (#efeae9) with white hairline cards at a 24px radius, warm near-black ink, an acid lime for pills, badges and the wordmark, and a baby pink for chat bubbles and glows. Montserrat throughout, light weight at big sizes.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a warm-ink sibling with the same lime and pink
paper is the muted token (most sections use bg-muted); white is background and card; the footer grey is secondary
Montserrat Variable is the original's own face (open licence)
name: typesomething-v2-theme
